label: Teltonika TSW202
description: A managed 8-port Gigabit PoE+ switch with two SFP cages - the managed counterpart of the TSW200, for a ring or a fibre uplink.
notes: Vendor figures (Teltonika datasheet teltonika-tsw-202): 8 x PoE ports with 802.3af/at and 2 x SFP cages, confirmed by the status-LED line (16 LAN LEDs, 2 SFP LEDs). Managed.

poe.note: Datasheet (TSW202, 2024-v1.1 Profinet), POE OUT block, verbatim: "PoE ports Port 1 - 8"; "PoE standards 802.3af and 802.3at Alternative B" (the Lithuanian product page gives the batch split: "Alternative A (From batch 42) / Alternative B (From batch 1-41)"); "PoE Max Power per Port (at PSE) 30 W"; "Total PoE Power Budget (at PSE) 240 W"; "Power consumption Idle: < 3 W / Max: 8 W / PoE Max: 248 W". Eight 30 W ports against a 240 W ceiling - full fill lands exactly on the budget. Read 2026-11-20; the QSG restates it as "Max PoE power budget at PSE 240 W*" with "* PoE operates properly only when connected power supply outputs 44 V or higher voltage" (https://wiki.teltonika-networks.com/view/QSG_TSW202).
